ideas.pitch: An automated anti-money laundering risk detection and investigation platform built with graph intelligence and LightGBM to analyze regional transactional anomalies in real-time.
ideas.title: ChaosLedger: Automated AML Risk Graph for Local FinTech
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the FinTech & Open Innovation track and leverages the proven technical architecture of Bito which won 1st place at the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon by combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool designed to detect unauthorized industrial land usage and environmental compliance breaches in real-time using geospatial imagery analysis.
ideas.title: AegisGrid: Industrial Land Compliance Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the HealthTech & Social Impact track by addressing local environmental monitoring concerns, utilizing the proven approach of GeoNex-ATLAS which won runner-up at the Xcelerate Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace where student freelancers can offer micro-services with automated milestone verification and USDC escrow payments settled on Base.
ideas.title: AgenticEscrow: Autonomous Gig Marketplace with USDC Settlement
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the FinTech & Open Innovation track by implementing production-grade payment escrows and autonomous agent workflows, echoing the exact success pattern of Dispatch at the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform tailored for local dietary habits, delivering personalized meal plans, glycemic insights, and micro-nutrient tracking within a 24-hour sprint scope.
ideas.title: NutriSync: AI Regional Diet & Wellness Optimization Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the HealthTech & Social Impact track perfectly, replicating the high-velocity execution and direct utility of E-Foodiee which won first prize at the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support platform combining LangGraph, local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and personalized agents to streamline campus resource navigation.
ideas.title: CampusGraph: Multi-Agent Student Support & Resource Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the AI & Machine Learning track priorities by demonstrating advanced multi-agent orchestration and RAG pipelines, similar to the winning entry of the GreenNovation Hackathon.
